description: Audit / true-up record: entitled count, installed count, the resulting gap, true-up cost, and audit-defense evidence. Triggered by vendor audit or proactive internal review. The artifact that justifies a SAM tool's ROI.

Active issued license or permit: license number, holder, type, issue date, expiration date, conditions, jurisdiction, current status (active / suspended / expired / revoked). The post-approval authoritative record.
Renewal application for an existing license: source license, renewal cycle, submission date, updated requirements, fees, conditions changes, outcome. Workflow distinct from initial issuance.

Qualifying event (marriage, birth, adoption, divorce, dependent loss-of-coverage, employment change) that opens a mid-year enrollment window. Triggers benefit_enrollments changes outside open enrollment.
LP entity + commitment + contributions-to-date + governance rights — required for LP compliance (K-1, consent tracking).

An individual head of livestock: identity, breed, sex, birth or acquisition date, current status, parentage, and the mob it belongs to. The animal-centric core record beef and sheep operations build their schema around.

An electronic or visual identifier attached to an animal (RFID / EID ear tag, national-scheme device number, management tag) and the traceability registration it carries. Jurisdiction-gated: the applicable scheme depends on where the operation runs.
A managed group of animals (mob, group, or lot) handled collectively for movements, treatments, and pasture allocation. The unit most day-to-day grazing operations actually operate on.

Borrower request to originate a loan: application date, requested amount, purpose, personal/commercial distinction, loan type (mortgage, auto, commercial line, term loan), requested tenor, collateral, guarantor status, lifecycle state (draft / submitted / approved / declined / funded).

Release of approved loan funds: loan_application reference, disbursement date, amount, tranching (full / phased), destination account, conditions satisfied, regulatory reporting flags. Carries funding state.
Application log stream entries, structured and unstructured. Indexed for search; correlated with metrics and traces for root-cause analysis.

FNOL event giving rise to a claim: occurrence date, location, loss description, cause, subtype (property damage, liability, injury, death), first-reported date. P&C-primary; distinct from ITSM incidents (internal IT operational events).

A customer enrolled in the loyalty program. Captures tier, accrued points balance, enrollment date, opt-in status. Distinct from the broader customers entity (CDP/CRM-mastered): a loyalty member is the program-side identity which may or may not match a CRM customer one-to-one (households, joint accounts, anonymous tier members in pre-identification flows).

A tier definition in the loyalty program (Bronze / Silver / Gold / Platinum or equivalent). Captures qualifying thresholds, benefits, retention rules. The reference catalog every loyalty_member is assigned to.
A point-earning or point-spending event for a loyalty_member: purchase points, bonus-promo points, redemption, expiry, adjustment. The atomic accounting record for the loyalty program.
Active capital commitment from an LP to a fund: committed_amount, called-to-date, distributed-to-date, NAV. The lifecycle record that capital_calls and fund_distributions reference.
KYC and AML output for an LP, including sanction-screening results, captured at subscription time and re-screened periodically.
Limited partners being fundraised — pre-commitment relationship stage. Distinct from `lp_commitments` which is post-close.
LP-facing performance report per fund per quarter: position-level marks, fund-level performance metrics, GP commentary, portfolio highlights. Locked when distributed.
Subscription document collected during LP onboarding: legal commitment to the fund at a stated dollar amount, KYC/AML results, accreditation attestation.
External Learning Record Store endpoints xAPI statements are routed to.
Per-job equipment telemetry log from CAN-bus / ISOBUS / OEM API (planting depth, application rate, GPS track, alarms).
Structured defect / non-conformance record (pre-work-order capture from DVIR or inspection).
Manager-directed reminder triggered when a direct report has overdue or upcoming training.

Manufacturing BOM (mBOM). The eBOM restructured for manufacturing assembly order, with phantom-part rollups, kitting, and process-specific decompositions. The mBOM feeds the MES / production planning system.

Routing master: ordered sequence of operations required to produce a part, with work center, setup time, run time, and resource allocations. Drives MES work-instruction generation and ERP standard-cost calculations.
A mooring ball in a mooring field: position, tackle, weight rating, and assigned vessel.
A wet berth at a dock: number, dock, length/beam/draft limits, utilities (power, water), and service status.
A defined slice of the market (industry, size, geography, motion) the plan targets.
Competitive, pricing, and churn-risk signals aggregated across the conversation corpus, summarizing what the market is saying in aggregate rather than on a single call.
A top-down assignment of budget from a marketing budget to a specific plan line, campaign, or channel, routed through approval and the unit against which spend is reconciled.
A pool of marketing funds for a period, business unit, or region that is approved and then allocated top-down across plans, plan lines, campaigns, and channels.
A shared campaign and content calendar that lays marketing activity out across time, teams, and channels, drawing its entries from plan lines for cross-team visibility and coordination.

Marketing campaign definitions — email blast, drip sequence, multi-channel, paid social tie-in, webinar series, ABM play. Carries target audience (segments), schedule, content variants, attribution settings, performance KPIs.

Email templates and sent instances at marketing scale: list-driven, volume-heavy, branded. Carries open/click/bounce/unsubscribe metrics, deliverability state, sender-reputation impact. Distinct from SALES-ENG `sales_emails` (1-1, rep-driven).
Lead-capture form definitions: fields, mapping to leads/contacts, hidden field rules, conditional logic, post-submit routing (lead score boost, nurture enroll, sales-rep notification).
A plan-level performance or marketing-ROI measure (results, pipeline contribution, return on marketing investment) computed against the plans and budgets that funded the activity.

A line within a marketing plan representing a planned activity, campaign, program, or initiative, carrying its objective, owner, time window, and allocated budget. The grain at which budget is allocated and spend is reconciled.
Annual or quarterly marketing plan: the top-level container that organizes objectives, plan lines, and budget for a marketing period and is approved before execution.

A committed or actual marketing expenditure (purchase order, invoice, or actual) attributed to a budget allocation and plan line, reconciled against allocated budget to compute remaining budget and variance.
Audit record of a matching or scoring batch: model version, inputs (skill profiles, opportunities, roles), outputs (fit scores, recommendations), timestamp.
Decision logic (exact / fuzzy / ML) identifying candidate duplicate records within or across sources; field weights, threshold scores.
Recorded meal and rest-break event evidencing compliance with labor-law break requirements (US state mandates, EU Working Time Directive). Carries waiver attestation where applicable.
Per-campaign media-buying plan broken down by outlet, channel, daypart, audience, flight dates, and budget allocation. Approved media plans convert into insertion_orders.

Medical equipment in clinical use (infusion pumps, ventilators, patient monitors, imaging systems, patient transport). Specialized regulated asset (FDA/MDR, biocompatibility); distinct from EAM industrial_assets (plant) and HAM hardware_assets (IT).
Matched mentor-mentee relationship with goals, cadence, and status.
Defines which source system's value wins per field when two records merge (survivorship: first/last/most-populated/highest-quality/custom).
Periodic compensation review cycle (annual, semi-annual, focal): budget pool, eligibility, calibration step, approval chain, effective date. The recurring operating model of comp management.
Per-employee per-cycle proposed merit increase, bonus, and equity refresh from manager, with calibration adjustments and final approval. Approved values become the pay-rate change posted to payroll.
A positioning and messaging house for a product or segment: pillars, proof points, and approved copy.
A periodic read of a utility meter, manual or wireless, that becomes a billable utility line.

Operator-collected or AMI-transmitted consumption reading: read date, consumption value, unit, read method (manual / AMR / AMI), anomaly flags. Billing-facing time-series at utility scale (millions of reads/day).
Row-level / metric-level ABAC policy at the semantic-definition tier (which BU sees which metric).

Canonical, certified definition of a business metric: numerator, denominator, filters, dimensions, time grain, ownership, certification status, and lineage to physical sources. The atom that the metrics-layer market exists to centralize and govern.
Cached or pre-aggregated metric rollup served from columnar storage by the semantic layer.

Time-series metric streams from instrumented applications — counters, gauges, histograms, summaries. The dev-instrumentation counterpart to ITOM's capacity_records, typically higher-cardinality and tied to release versions.
Bulk-tank or per-cow milk-quality result: SCC, bacterial count, butterfat, protein, antibiotic-residue screen.
Per-cow per-session milking event: parlor / robot ID, milk yield, conductivity, milking duration; from parlor / AMS telemetry.
Training metadata for AIOps ML models (feature set, training window, model version, accuracy, retraining schedule).

Registered machine-learning model with versions, training-data lineage, evaluation metrics, deployment endpoints, and approval state. Backed by the platform's model registry. Distinct from PA's predictive_models, which is the HR-specific attrition-modeling concept consumed inside People Analytics workflows.
A recorded movement of a mob between paddocks, properties, or to an external destination, with date, head count, origin, destination, and reason. Feeds traceability-scheme movement reporting.
App distribution unit: app identifier, version, manifest, app-store link (public store or custom), install silently flag. Distinct from APM `enterprise_applications` (business app portfolio).
AI-generated next-move suggestions for an employee, with rationale and freshness.
An observed insider activity event captured from endpoint, email, file, cloud, identity, or removable-media telemetry. The raw substrate that scoring and detection rules evaluate.

Filtered, human-relevant subset of events that crossed a threshold, matched a pattern, or were enriched with priority and routing. Alerts are what gets paged or ticketed; events are what feeds the correlation engine.

Raw event from a monitored system — state change, threshold crossing, status update, log signal. The firehose, volume-heavy and noisy. AIOPS consumes the full stream for correlation; alerts are the human-relevant subset.
What to monitor, at what frequency, with what thresholds, for which CIs. Often auto-bound to CIs by class via DISCOVERY — a new web-server CI inherits the web-server monitoring policy by default.

An MSP's end-customer organization: site/location hierarchy, contact directory, contract portfolio, and asset estate. The MSP's view of its client roster; distinct from customers (which represent product-company customers in CRM/CSM context).

Multi-flavor service contract between an MSP and an end-customer: block-hour, retainer, value-based, per-device, or managed-services. Tracks consumption, renewal dates, SLA terms, and per-contract billing rules.

Invoice generated by the MSP to its end-customer: recurring service-subscription line items + out-of-contract billable work + tax. Distinct from customer_invoices (SUB-MGMT, software-vendor-issued) and invoices (S2P, AP-side).

Billable service ticket against an MSP service contract: customer tenant, contract reference, time-tracked work logs, billable/non-billable category, SLA timer, dispatch state. Distinct from ITSM-mastered incidents (internal-IT-flavored) — same shape, different buyer and lifecycle.
Per-ticket / per-contract / per-customer technician time entry, with category tagging, billable/non-billable classification, approval state, and downstream feed into payroll and billing.
Third-party store quality assessment (customer experience, compliance, staff courtesy). Distinct from internal store_audits.
Government-issued identity numbers for a worker, such as social security or national insurance numbers, held with restricted access and validity dates. Jurisdiction-specific.
A set of negotiation rules and fallback positions that guide how clauses may be redlined and what concessions are pre-approved.
Historical baseline performance profile (median/p95 latency, loss, jitter) per path/flow/link segment. Used for anomaly detection and alert tuning.
Captured packet/session flows with source/destination IPs, ports, protocols, bytes transferred, duration. The raw observation unit for NPMD traffic analysis.
Physical or virtual network interface on monitored devices (adapters, ports, logical channels). Collection point for flow capture; distinct from CMDB device CI.

Logical/physical network inventory mastered by the telco operator: ports, circuits, IP address blocks, fiber routes, MSAN/DSLAM ports, allocated/free status. Distinct from NPMD network observability (`network_flow_records` etc.) and CMDB `configuration_items`.
Path trace result from source to destination: ordered hop sequence with per-hop latency, cumulative loss rates, RTT. Used for end-to-end path diagnostics.
Threshold breach or anomaly on network performance metrics. Carries severity, affected path/flow, baseline correlation. Network-specific (vs generic OBS alerts).
Time-series of latency, jitter, packet loss, throughput sampled across flows, links, application paths. Primary signal for network SLO/KPI reporting.
Periodic capture of network connectivity: device adjacency, link status, interface roles. Used for topology visualization and root-cause correlation.
Performance × Potential 3x3 grid placement per worker per cycle. Drives succession_plans, high-potential identification, and differentiated investment.
Record-triggered workflow / scheduled job / external API call defined in the no-code platform.
User-defined container for a no-code-database deployment: a self-contained namespace for tables, views, automations, and access.
Public or authenticated intake form authored in the no-code database.

User-defined schema inside a no-code base — tables, fields with types, linked-record relationships, formulas, and views. The 'meta' the platform actually masters; the records themselves are user-owned data the platform stores without owning their semantics.
Switchable presentation layer (grid, gallery, kanban, calendar, timeline) over a no-code base.
Reusable email / in-app / chat template with merge fields, used by automation rules and manager nudges.

Multi-touch outbound nurture flows — branching paths, wait conditions, exit criteria, content trees. The orchestrated counterpart to CDP `customer_journeys`; MA defines, CDP observes resulting behavior.
A learner's scored result against an observation checklist, with observer signoff.
On-the-job competency checklist an observer scores against; field-skill assessment.
Real-time or snapshot occupancy state for a space: desk booked, room reserved, actual check-in via badge/mobile.
A medical surveillance and exposure record such as a respirator fit test, audiometric test, or fitness-for-duty evaluation, retained per occupational-health rules.

Federal-contractor audit log of every applicant-flow event (requisition open, application receipt, disposition, hire) carrying the actor, timestamp, and OFCCP-relevant fields needed to reconstruct compliance decisions during an audit. Immutable append-only.
Approval step in the offer-approval chain (HRBP -> Comp -> Finance -> Exec). Triggered when an offer exceeds band, includes non-standard equity, or matches other escalation rules.
